nb55e9a0374.summary: A 34 million euro investment will transform the Corinth Canal under the management of AEDIK, including slope reinforcement and 12-month uninterrupted operation. Plans also include VIP services and digital modernisation.
nb55e9a0374.why: The Corinth Canal is a key Greek shipping shortcut, so upgrades affect transit reliability and maritime traffic revenue.

n12f4a7b61c.headline: Two Philippine business giants plan to form a mining company
n12f4a7b61c.summary: Philippine conglomerates SM Investments and DMCI Holdings are preparing groundwork to build the country's largest mining company. The report gave no further terms of the plan.
n12f4a7b61c.why: SM Investments is a diversified Philippine conglomerate, and DMCI Holdings is a construction and mining group, so their combined mining venture would bring together major local corporate capital.

nbdbd513ef3.headline: Dávid Vitézy makes huge announcement: hundreds of thousands of Hungarians may soon get housing, here is the government's plan
nbdbd513ef3.summary: Hungarian government plans, presented by Dávid Vitézy, aim to create affordable rental housing, student dormitories and liveable neighbourhoods. Practical implementation begins early next year.
nbdbd513ef3.why: Government housing programmes financed by EU funds and private capital affect construction activity and the rental market.

n5e07d1be9e.headline: Banks back sweeping regulatory reforms
n5e07d1be9e.summary: Commercial banks have backed changes to Malawi's banking laws in the Banking (Amendment) Bill, 2026. Bankers Association of Malawi president Phillip Madinga said the bill gives the Reserve Bank of Malawi more options to intervene before problems at individual banks spread.
n5e07d1be9e.why: Banking law changes set how regulators can act on troubled lenders, which shapes depositor protection and investor confidence in the banking sector.

n95ebd826cb.headline: 62 commercial vessels redirected, three disabled amid US blockade on Iran: CENTCOM
n95ebd826cb.summary: US Central Command said its forces have redirected 62 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two while enforcing a blockade against Iran. The action comes amid competing claims over control of the Strait of Hormuz.
n95ebd826cb.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global oil shipments, so disruptions there affect crude prices and shipping costs.
n95ebd826cb.why_moved: The input reports vessels redirected and disabled amid competing claims over the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transit route, which raises supply-disruption risk.

ne122c98085.headline: European shares snap 4-week rally as higher oil prices temper strong earnings
ne122c98085.summary: European stocks closed lower on Friday, ending a four-week winning streak. Higher crude oil prices and rising geopolitical tensions overshadowed strong corporate earnings, though the STOXX 600 stayed near record levels.
ne122c98085.why: The STOXX 600 tracks large European companies across sectors and is a benchmark for regional equity performance. Oil prices feed into inflation and corporate costs across the region.
ne122c98085.why_moved: Higher crude oil prices and escalating geopolitical tensions overshadowed robust corporate earnings. Investors began reallocating portfolios after the four-week winning streak.

n214143d708.headline: PM Modi Sets 100 GW Nuclear Energy Target by 2047, Highlights India’s Energy Self-Reliance
n214143d708.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India targets 100 GW of nuclear capacity by 2047 and is advancing five new reactors. He also highlighted fast breeder technology, piped gas and solar power.
n214143d708.why: Nuclear and other power capacity expansion drives long-term demand for engineering, construction and equipment suppliers. Energy security policy affects India's import needs and industrial costs.

n0fbf1a65f2.headline: Oil inches toward $90 on tanker attacks, lack of progress in Iran war peace deal
n0fbf1a65f2.summary: Brent crude closed at $88.52 a barrel and WTI at $82.40 after tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and disruption at a Russian port reduced shipping. Peace talks have stalled.
n0fbf1a65f2.why: Brent and WTI are the main global benchmarks for crude oil, so supply disruptions in key shipping lanes feed directly into fuel costs, inflation expectations and energy equities.

impacts.name: WTI crude
impacts.why: WTI settled higher on the same supply concerns that lifted Brent.

n0fbf1a65f2.why_moved: Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and a disruption at a Russian port reduced shipping activity, while peace talks over the Iran war made no progress. Storage levels were described as more resilient, which partly limits the rise.

n065c7efc47.headline: Iran, Oman home in on Hormuz Strait deal as ship attacks mount
n065c7efc47.summary: Iran and Oman are nearing a deal on managing the Strait of Hormuz to ensure safe passage, as ship attacks mount. The US is preparing new economic measures against Iran.
n065c7efc47.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so disruptions there feed directly into global crude prices.

n6dff79d52c.headline: Gold rises on weaker dollar as inflation data cements rate-hold bets
n6dff79d52c.summary: Gold prices rose on Friday, helped by a weaker dollar and stable inflation figures that reduced the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Oil also gained over the week on Strait of Hormuz tensions.
n6dff79d52c.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that often moves inversely to the US dollar and real interest rates. Its price is set in global markets, with London the main over-the-counter hub.
n6dff79d52c.why_moved: A weaker dollar and inflation data that lowered the chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike supported gold.

nba7d0be7cc.headline: After Trump comment on declaring Strait of Hormuz US territory, Tehran says it 'will remain Iranian' - AOL
nba7d0be7cc.summary: After a Trump comment about declaring the Strait of Hormuz US territory, Tehran said the waterway 'will remain Iranian'. Commercial vessels were pictured anchored in the strait off Bandar Abbas.
nba7d0be7cc.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so any dispute over its status matters for energy markets.

nc38bf27de1.headline: ‘No-go’ to ‘go ahead’ areas: PM Modi hails ‘Samrudha Manthan’ for deep-sea exploration in Independence Day speech
nc38bf27de1.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed the opening of most of India's coastal waters for exploration under the Samudra Manthan initiative. The policy shift covers deep-sea exploration.
nc38bf27de1.why: Opening coastal waters to exploration could support offshore resource development and related investment in India.

n5b4800c6eb.headline: UAE says Iran attacked vessel in Strait of Hormuz for third time this week
n5b4800c6eb.summary: The UAE said Iran attacked a state-owned oil vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz for the third time this week. The attack was reported on Saturday.
n5b4800c6eb.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so attacks on tankers raise supply risk and insurance costs. The UAE is a major oil exporter.
n5b4800c6eb.why_moved: Repeated attacks on a state-owned oil vessel in the Strait of Hormuz raise supply and shipping risk.

n7c7ce16322.headline: PM Modi Says India Must Cut Crude Oil Dependence, Opens Offshore Areas For Exploration
n7c7ce16322.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India's reliance on imported crude reflects limited domestic exploration. He highlighted opening offshore areas, expanding nuclear and solar power, and wider piped gas access.
n7c7ce16322.why: India is one of the world's largest oil importers, so its energy policy shapes global crude demand and import bills. Domestic exploration and power diversification affect long-term energy security.

n42ef16c82b.headline: Oil prices rally, US data dents chances of Fed rate hike
n42ef16c82b.summary: Global shares declined Friday as markets watched US-Iran talks and Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations. Oil rose more than a dollar a barrel amid escalating tensions and faltering peace talks.
n42ef16c82b.why: Oil prices feed directly into inflation and corporate costs, and Federal Reserve rate expectations shape the valuation of equities globally.
n42ef16c82b.why_moved: Escalating US-Iran tensions and faltering peace talks lifted oil prices, while weaker US consumer sentiment and Fed rate-hike expectations weighed on stocks.

n95e9d3b518.headline: Institutional investors reveal cautious approach to tech favorites in US quarterly 13F filings
n95e9d3b518.summary: Institutional investors made slight reductions in holdings of prominent tech firms in the second quarter, while semiconductor stocks kept a positive outlook and AI-themed stocks saw less traction.
n95e9d3b518.why: Quarterly 13F filings disclose the US equity holdings of large institutional managers, offering a view of where big money positioned itself.

nd86960af53.headline: CATL and Quinbrook Build on Supernode Partnership Following Stage 2 and Stage 3 Major Milestones
nd86960af53.summary: Quinbrook's Supernode battery energy storage project has completed Stage 2 commercial operation and reached a further milestone. CATL is building on its partnership with Quinbrook.
nd86960af53.why: CATL is one of the world's largest battery makers, and grid-scale storage projects drive demand for its battery systems.

n91f48685db.headline: Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill to bring long-term stability to sector
n91f48685db.summary: The government said the recently passed Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill, 2026, brings long-term stability to the minerals sector and attracts investment.
n91f48685db.why: Mining law changes affect licensing, investment returns and supply of metals used in manufacturing, making them relevant to mining and industrial companies.

n398bbea60f.headline: UAE says Iran attacked ADNOC vessel in Hormuz, urges waterway's reopening
n398bbea60f.summary: The UAE said Iran attacked an Abu Dhabi National Oil Company vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz, with no injuries reported. The UAE foreign ministry called on Tehran to halt its actions.
n398bbea60f.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil transit chokepoint, and ADNOC is the state oil company of Abu Dhabi. Disruption there can quickly affect global crude supply and prices.

nd4e20a7838.headline: Income Tax Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme 2026: Who Can Declare Undisclosed Overseas Assets, Tax Rates and Deadlines
nd4e20a7838.summary: The Income Tax Department notified rules for the 2026 Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme. Eligible taxpayers can declare undisclosed overseas assets up to Rs 1 crore, or previously taxed assets up to Rs 5 crore, by paying specified tax or fees.
nd4e20a7838.why: Tax disclosure schemes allow taxpayers to regularise overseas holdings and bring undeclared wealth into the formal tax system.

n52a1d7e345.headline: Petrol strike averted as govt gives in to dealers
n52a1d7e345.summary: Pakistan's government gave in to demands from petrol dealers, averting a planned petrol strike. No further terms were specified in the input.
n52a1d7e345.why: Fuel supply disruptions in Pakistan affect transport costs and inflation, which matter for local companies and debt markets.

ne9f2b1b275.headline: Taiwan passes annual budget after long delay, including drone spending
ne9f2b1b275.summary: Taiwan's opposition-controlled parliament approved this year's government budget late on Friday after a record delay. The budget includes spending on a key drone programme.
ne9f2b1b275.why: Taiwan's budget sets government spending on defence and industry, and delays affect public investment and contractor planning.

n2d9456f369.headline: Govt cuts windfall gains on petrol to zero; diesel, ATF duties also reduced
n2d9456f369.summary: India lowered the special additional excise duty on diesel exports to ₹24 per litre from ₹25.5 and on ATF exports to ₹19.5 from ₹22. Petrol windfall gains duty was set to zero.
n2d9456f369.why: Windfall levies are taxes on refiners' export margins. Changes to them affect refiners' profitability and fuel export flows.

n4c4fc0e4ac.headline: Outside TSMC, ordinary Taiwanese remain detached from its bonuses, Taiwan's 10% growth
n4c4fc0e4ac.summary: Taiwan's economy has grown about 10%, while an Academia Sinica study cited in the report finds ordinary Taiwanese remain detached from TSMC's bonuses.
n4c4fc0e4ac.why: Taiwan's economy is heavily driven by semiconductors, and TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker.

n141e4ad1ed.headline: Portugal lends at 2.93% versus 3.48% in the euro area, and the credit problem is not the interest rate
n141e4ad1ed.summary: Portuguese credit costs stand at 2.93% against 3.48% in the euro area, according to an Observador analysis. The article argues that housing affordability, not interest rates, is the core credit problem.
n141e4ad1ed.why: Mortgage and credit conditions shape household demand and banking sector lending volumes in the euro area.
